description: This file contains comprehensive unit tests for Orleans' support of generic grains and interfaces, including various scenarios such as multiple type parameters, inheritance, type constraints, complex generic hierarchies, and edge cases. It uses Xunit for testing and references multiple external interfaces and classes related to Orleans grains.

classes.name: GenericGrainTests
classes.description: Contains a wide range of unit tests validating Orleans' support for generic grains and interfaces, including complex scenarios and edge cases.

classes.name: GenericEdgeCaseTests
classes.description: Contains tests for edge cases in Orleans' generic grain type system, including partial specialization, repeated type parameters, and complex type inference scenarios.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: Retrieves a grain reference of a specified generic interface type, optionally with an ID.

methods.name: GetRandomGrainId
methods.description: Generates a random grain ID for testing purposes.
